_note: Which draw ships per bed, chosen by MEASUREMENT (audio/qa/music_draws_measured.json from `measure.py draws`). Empty until the first music pass. One entry per bed that is NOT served by its plan's first draw, e.g. "base_loop_a": {"src": "pf_base92a_v2__1", "why": "v1 chug 4.8 -> v2 1.9"}. Optional keys: bpmOverride (measured tempo when the onset comb is ambiguous), start (bars to skip after the first onset). One redraw per NAMED, MEASURED defect; the better draw by measurement ships; never a blind re-roll. Build-side keys added 2026-09-25: semis (whole-mix rubberband transposition for a draw in the wrong centre), onsetAfter (seconds of near-silence to skip before looking for the first onset), bars (a shorter whole-bar loop when the draw does not hold the planned length).

base_loop_a.why: measure.py draws 2026-09-25: pf_base92a__1 opens with ~5 s (2 bars) of sparse intro at -27 dB against a -17 dB body ('quiet intro -10.5 dB'); the draw's closing decay starts at 87.7 s, so a 32-bar loop (83.48 s) can start at bar 1 at the latest; the remaining quiet bar is lifted by build_audio.bar_lift. Interim: this draw also measures chug 3.99, C-pent 0.56, sections 2-3 r 0.906 -> redraw requested (pf_base92a_v2).

rescue_loop.why: measure.py draws 2026-09-25: pf_rescue100__1's first 2 bars (4.8 s) sit ~5 dB under the body (sparser intro); starting at bar 1 leaves one quiet bar for bar_lift and still ends (79.26 s) before the closing decay (~81 s).

inferno_loop.why: measure.py draws 2026-09-25: pf_inferno100__1 came back in C minor/dorian (chroma C .24, Bb .17, G .13, Eb .09; C-pent share 0.546) instead of the planned A-minor pentatonic, so E and A of the hook and every C-pentatonic ladder would clash with its Eb/Bb. A rubberband -3 st transposition puts it on A (A dorian: top G E A C B) -> key-fit share 0.47 -> 0.76, C-pent 0.74 (+2 st, D dorian, measured 0.68/0.70 and moves the centre off A). Interim until pf_inferno100_v2 is drawn.

backdraft_spins_layer.why: measure.py draws 2026-09-25: pf_backdraft92__1 is near-silent (-40 dB) for its first 5.25 s (2 bars) and decays from 44.5 s, the entry (first sample within 12 dB of the draw's peak after 4.5 s) is at 5.275 s; it holds 15.0 bars of material, not the 16 planned; the layer ships as 12 whole bars (three 4-bar phrases, even, so the two-bar brass stabs stay on the base bed's grid; the runtime phase-aligns layers modulo their own loop). Redraw requested (pf_backdraft92_v2) for the planned 16.

anticipation_layer.why: measure.py draws 2026-09-25: pf_antic92__1 opens with 0.6 s of a -35..-44 dB pre-roll before the roll enters at ~0.7 s (-17 dB); the 4-bar layer starts at that entry (measured 0.775 s: the first sample within 12 dB of the draw's peak) so the loop head is not a dip (it ends at 11.1 s, before the draw's closing decay at ~12.8 s). Tempo: the layer is a continuous roll + tremolo, so the onset comb has no beat to lock to (fine_tempo 93.75 from only the 8/16-beat lags of a 16 s draw, autocorr 81.1, envelope comb 89-90): no reliable measurement, so bpmOverride 92 = the plan's tempo, no stretch (a 1.9% stretch toward a spurious 93.75 would only add WSOLA smear).
